description:
Facebook Pages Scraper: Posts, Pages & Comments

Public Facebook Pages without login: page info with exact follower counts, the latest posts with text, reactions, comments, shares and media, and single post pages with visible comments. No cookies, no browser. $1.00 per 1,000 posts.

Pricing (pay per event, billed to your Apify account): Post: $0.001; Page: $0.002; Comment: $0.0005.

Runs on Apify as subimpact/facebook-pages-scraper.

_maxChargeUsd.description: Per-run spending cap in USD (default 0.5). Passed to Apify as the run option maxTotalChargeUsd, so the run stops when it reaches this charge.
_maxChargeUsd.title: Max charge (USD)

_maxItems.description: How many dataset items to return to the model (1-1000, default 50). Truncates the response only; it does not change what the Actor collects or charges for.
_maxItems.title: Max items returned

includeComments.description: For each single post link, also deliver the comments that the post page shows. Comments are charged as comment rows. Only the comments facebook.com renders are available; there are no further comment pages.
includeComments.title: Include visible comments of post links

maxCommentsPerPost.description: How many visible comments to keep for each single post link (0 to 100). 0 turns comments off without changing Include comments.
maxCommentsPerPost.title: Comments per post

maxItems.description: Hard cap on charged rows in one run: page rows plus post and comment rows (1 to 10000). The run stops cleanly when the cap is reached.
maxItems.title: Max rows per run

maxPostsPerPage.description: How many of a page's latest posts to deliver (0 to 50). 0 delivers the page row only. facebook.com serves about 20 posts per page with no deeper pagination, so asking for more does not fetch older posts.
maxPostsPerPage.title: Posts per page

pageUrls.description: Public Facebook Pages to read. Any of these forms works: NASA, @NASA, https://www.facebook.com/NASA, a page tab link such as https://www.facebook.com/NASA/about (read as the page itself), https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100044561550831. Each page gives one page row plus its latest posts. Give pageUrls, postUrls, or both.
pageUrls.title: Facebook Pages

postUrls.description: Facebook post, video, reel or photo permalinks such as https://www.facebook.com/NASA/posts/<id>, https://www.facebook.com/NASA/videos/<id>, /reel/<id> or https://www.facebook.com/photo/?fbid=<id>. A page link pasted here is read as the page. Each link gives that post plus, when Include comments is on, the comments the page shows. Leave empty to scrape only the pages above.
postUrls.title: Single post links (optional)

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify datacenter proxy is the default. If facebook.com answers a page with its login page, the actor retries it on fresh sessions and then once through the RESIDENTIAL proxy, unless you pick your own proxy groups here. A proxy failure fails the request and never falls back to a direct request.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

name: facebook_pages
